turns.customer: My son dropped the Firefly headlamp from order #1074 on the rocks at camp and the lens shattered. Can I get a refund for it?
turns.reply: Since the headlamp was dropped and damaged after delivery, it isn't eligible for a return or refund under our policy. Accidental damage and drops aren't covered, though our 1-year warranty covers manufacturing defects that show up in normal use. If you think this was a defect rather than accidental damage, I can escalate this to a team member for you. Thanks for understanding.
